name: Cafe Renaissance

location.address: Dadman Blvd, after Atieh Hospital, between Bostan & Golestan, No. 41, Shahrak Gharb, Tehran

media.alt: Boho-style wood and greenery interior of Cafe Renaissance

description: A boho-styled cafe-restaurant on Dadman Boulevard, mixing warm wood, soft light, and oversized cacti into a favorite local photo spot. Has both an indoor hall and an outdoor courtyard, plus a VIP room for parties.
